shots.caption: Cover: hero convertible on the Boardwalk at golden hour, pastel deco blocks, palms and billboards behind, title burned in.
Driving downtown with traffic ahead, full HUD with cash and bank, Fixer reputation XP bar, a live courier job, mission timer and live minimap.
Three wanted stars: two SBPD interceptors with flashing lightbars chasing the player coupe down the Neon Mile at golden hour.
On foot on the Boardwalk promenade among pedestrians, glowing mission pillar ahead, shells on the sand and the ocean beyond.
